class.jaymoskingdoms.option.bulwark.desc: A dome of packed earth round you for a few seconds. Shots that fly at it are turned back, and foes inside it are shoved out.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.tide_pearl.d: Throw a pearl of water. What it strikes is dragged to a ring at your feet, cut and slowed.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.harrying_gal: The foe you look at is tossed a short way again and again, and hurt each time it lands.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.sorc_bulwark.name: Bulwark
spell.jaymoskingdoms.sorc_bulwark.descri: A dome of packed earth turns shots and shoves foes back.
spell.jaymoskingdoms.sorc_tide_pearl.des: A thrown pearl of water drags what it strikes to your feet.
Toss the foe you look at, again and again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stitch.cold: The red thread means nothing to you.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stitch.known: You already know where the needle goes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stitch.learned: The thread in the margin pulls tight. You know where the needle goes.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stitch.unready: The thread is in you, but your hand is not steady enough yet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stitch.wants: It wants %1$s red dust and %2$s bones.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stitch.broken: The thread snaps in your hand.
message.jaymoskingdoms.stitch.done: It stands. It was not asked.
message.jaymoskingdoms.theft.cry.unmakin: What have you done to them?! Guards, the witch!
It was one of us! Look what they made of it!
